board.label: Chess board. You play {side, select, white {White} other {Black}}. The arrow keys move the cursor. Enter picks a piece and then the square it goes to.

promotion.label: Choose the piece the pawn becomes

tutorial.title: How to play Chess

opponent.title: The opponent moves first
opponent.body: Every puzzle starts with the opponent's last move. Here Black took the rook off the back rank. That was a mistake, and it is up to you to punish it.

move.title: Make your move
move.body: Drag a piece, or tap it and then tap the square it goes to. The dots show where it can go. Find the checkmate in 1 move.

tutorial.doneBody: Sofia, the coach, comments on every move. If you get one wrong, she explains what the move allows: tap the board to take it back and try again. The first hint shows the piece, the second plays the move. The clock only stops when the puzzle is solved.
